blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many LLM benchmarks for languages other than English are translated, multiple-choice, or difficult to score automatically. We introduce The Shared Word (TSW-NL), a Dutch benchmark built around four core principles: it is language-specific, open-vocabulary, human-curated, and deterministically scored. Each puzzle gives three clues that describe different senses or uses of the same Dutch word. The clues are individually ambiguous, requiring the solver to combine evidence across multiple clues. We construct the benchmark from Dutch Wikipedia disambiguation pages, followed by automatic filtering and extensive manual curation. The final dataset contains 222 instances, with three independent human answers per test item. The task is clearly challenging: scores in our human study range from 49.5% to 61.0% and the highest-scoring open-weight model we tested reaches only 39.3%. Many others even score below 20%. At the same time, closed-source models show great progress: GPT-4.1 (April 2025) scores 59.2%, whereas GPT-5.6 Sol with max reasoning scores 88.8%. We believe this task provides a useful addition to Dutch model evaluation, plus a clear recipe that can be applied to construct a similar benchmark for other languages.
blocks.zh: 许多英语以外的语言的LLM基准被翻译,多选择,或难以自动得分. 我们引入了《共同言语》(TSW-NL),这是荷兰的一项基准,它围绕四个核心原则:语言、公开投票、人语、定分。 每个谜题都给出了三个线索来描述同名荷兰语词的不同感想或使用. 线索个别模糊不清,需要解题者将跨多条线索的证据相融合. 我们从荷兰维基百科的解析页面构建基准, 最终数据集包含222个实例,每个测试项目有三个独立的人类答案. 这项任务显然具有挑战性:我们人类研究的分数从49.5%到61.0%不等,我们测试的最高分开放量模型只达到39.3%。 还有许多人甚至得分低于20%。 同时,闭源模型显示出了巨大的进步:GPT-4.1 (2025年4月)得分59.2%,而GPT-5.6 Sol最大推理得分88.8%. 我们认为,这项任务为荷兰模式评价提供了有益的补充,并提供了可以适用于为其他语文构建类似基准的明确方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reliable benchmarking is important for understanding what large language models (LLMs) can and cannot do, in particular for languages other than English. Many of the benchmarks commonly used for such languages are directly translated from English, making it unclear whether LLMs are truly capable in those languages. Similarly, many tasks are multiple-choice, which only test whether the models recognize the correct answer, instead of generating it themselves. Moreover, tasks that require generation often have unclear and fuzzy evaluation metrics, making comparison between models hard.
blocks.zh: 可靠的基准对于了解大型语言模型能够和不能做什么,特别是对于英语以外的语言而言,是重要的。 通常用于这些语言的许多基准都直接从英文翻译出来,因此不清楚这些语言的法学硕士是否真正有能力。 同样,许多任务都是多选择的,只能测试模型是否识别正确的答案,而不是自己生成. 此外,需要生成的任务往往有不明确和模糊的评价指标,使模型之间的比较变得难以进行。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Example puzzle. The three Dutch clues describe a football coach (Dick Advocaat), an alcoholic drink (Dutch-specific, similar to eggnog), and a profession (lawyer), all answered by advocaat .
blocks.zh: 图 1:示例谜题. 荷兰的三条线索描述了一名足球教练(英语:Dick Advocaat),一名酒精饮料(荷兰语特写,类似于蛋诺),以及一名职业(律师),均由advocaat回答.

blocks.en: To address these issues, we introduce a Dutch benchmark based on four simple principles:
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们根据四项简单原则制定了荷兰基准:

blocks.en: 1. The benchmark is language-specific: the lexical relation between its clues and answer does not survive direct translation. 2. The benchmark requires open-vocabulary generation. 3. Each item has one short intended answer and can be scored deterministically. 4. All items in the benchmark are human-verified and curated.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 基准为语言特异性:其线索和答案之间的语法关系无法幸存直接翻译. 2. 基准需要开放式的省内发电。 3. 每个项目有一个简短的预期答案,可以确定答案。 4. 基准中的所有项目都是经人核查和整理的。

blocks.en: The benchmark is language-specific: the lexical relation between its clues and answer does not survive direct translation.
blocks.zh: 基准为语言特异性:其线索和答案之间的语法关系无法幸存直接翻译.

blocks.en: The benchmark requires open-vocabulary generation.
blocks.zh: 该基准需要开放式的省内发电。

blocks.en: Each item has one short intended answer and can be scored deterministically.
blocks.zh: 每个项目都有一个简短的预期答案,可以确定得分。

blocks.en: All items in the benchmark are human-verified and curated.
blocks.zh: 基准中的所有项目都是经过人验证和整理的。

blocks.en: This may sound straightforward, but finding benchmarks that meet all four requirements is surprisingly difficult. 1 1 1 See Appendix Tables 7 – 9 for a detailed comparison.
blocks.zh: 这听起来可能很直接,但找到符合所有四项要求的基准却十分困难。 1 1 详见附录表7-9。

blocks.en: The task we introduce consists of three clues that all point to a single Dutch word. Figure 1 shows an example. It is inspired by a popular question type in the Dutch TV quiz Met Het Mes Op Tafel . There are no answer options or predefined labels. The model must interpret the clues, combine them, and retrieve the word from an open vocabulary. The clues are curated around one intended answer and they are deliberately underspecified as not to point to only a single term. We use disambiguation pages of Dutch Wikipedia to create our dataset. After extensive filtering, we manually curated it to ensure, among other things, that the three clues collectively admit only one intended answer, the examples cannot be translated while preserving the same answer, and the clues are distinctly different and do not contain obscure words or references. Importantly, we want a task that is still doable for humans, so the LLM capabilities can be evaluated in the light of human performance as well.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍的任务包括三个线索,它们都指向一个荷兰语单词. 图1显示了一个实例。 由荷兰电视试播集Met Het Mes Op Tafel中流行的提问类型所启发。 没有答案选项或预定义的标签. 模型必须解释线索,将它们结合起来,并从一个开放的词汇中检索到这个词. 线索围绕一个预定的答案来整理,并且刻意将线索小写为不只指一个词. 我们使用荷兰维基百科的解析页面来创建我们的数据集. 经过广泛的过滤后,我们手动整理,以确保,除其他外,三个线索集体只承认一个预期的答案,实例在保留同一个答案的同时无法翻译,线索明显不同,并不包含晦涩的词语或引用. 重要的是,我们需要一项对人类来说仍然可行的任务,因此LLM能力也可以根据人类的表现来评价.

blocks.en: Dutch already has strong resources: DUMB combines nine language-understanding tasks, the EuroEval Natural Language Understanding benchmark includes Dutch, and BEIR-NL tests information retrieval ( de Vries et al., 2023 ; Saattrup Nielsen et al., 2025 ; Lotfi et al., 2025 ) . What our work adds is a difficult free-generation task that is easy to score. We also test whether models adapted to Dutch, such as GEITje, Fietje 2 and ChocoLlama ( Vanroy, 2024 ; Vanroy, 2025 ; Meeus et al., 2024 ) , perform relatively better on a Dutch-specific benchmark such as this one.
blocks.zh: 荷兰已经拥有强大的资源: DUMB结合了九个语言理解的任务,EuroEval自然语言理解基准包括荷兰语,BEIR-NL测试信息检索(de Vries等人,2023年;Saattrup Nielsen等人,2025年;Lotfi等人,2025年). 我们的工作补充的是一项困难的自由一代任务,很容易得分。 我们还测试适应荷兰语的模型,如GEITje、Fietje 2和ChocoLlama(Vanroy,2024年;Vanroy,2025年;Meeus等人,2024年),是否在荷兰特有的基准上表现较好,例如这一基准。

blocks.en: The final, heavily curated test set contains 200 instances, each answered by three human annotators. Experiments show that the benchmark has a useful level of difficulty. All evaluated open-weight models struggle, given that the strongest approach only reaches 39.3% accuracy. There are still clear differences between the models, indicating that our benchmark seems to distinguish well between different model capabilities. The strongest closed models perform much better: they clearly exceed the scores of our human annotators, while still being quite far from perfect.
blocks.zh: 最终的,精心配制的测试集包含200个实例,每个实例都由3个人类注释员回答. 实验显示,该基准有有用的难度水平. 所有评价的开放量模型都挣扎不休,因为最强的方法只达到39.3%。 模型之间仍然有明显的区别,表明我们的基准似乎对不同的模型能力作了很好的区分. 最强的封闭模型表现得更好:它们显然超过了我们人类的注释员的分数,而仍然远远不够完美。

blocks.en: While the benchmark itself is language-specific, the process that creates it is not. Our main contribution is therefore a novel NLP task for testing language-specific lexical knowledge, candidate retrieval, and evidence integration through an open-vocabulary task that does not transfer directly across languages. In particular, we release TSW-NL , a carefully curated set of 222 Dutch puzzle instances that serves as a useful addition to current Dutch LLM evaluation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 虽然基准本身是语言特有的,但创建基准的过程却并非如此。 因此,我们的主要贡献是新型的NLP任务,通过不直接跨语言传输的开放-vobulary任务,测试语言特有的词汇知识,候选检索,以及证据整合. 特别是,我们发布了TSW-NL, 一套精心整理的222个荷兰谜题,

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
In a sense, our benchmark runs word-sense disambiguation in reverse ( Navigli, 2009 ) . Instead of mapping a given word to a fixed sense inventory, the solver recovers the word from several senses or conventional uses. It also resembles riddle and lateral-reasoning benchmarks ( Lin et al., 2021 ; Jiang et al., 2023b ; Manna et al., 2024 ; Samdarshi et al., 2024 ; Saha et al., 2025 ; Gevers and Daelemans, 2026 ) , but is language-specific and has no answer choices. Solving it requires lexical knowledge, candidate search, and evidence integration. The retrieval direction is close to the reverse dictionary task, where a description is used to find a word ( Hill et al., 2016 ; Pilehvar, 2019 ; Yan et al., 2020 ; Qi et al., 2020 ) .
However, our task is quite different. For one, reverse dictionary systems typically recover a word from a description of just one sense. Moreover, here each clue is deliberately underspecified and describes a different sense. Potential solvers must therefore combine candidates across clues, with the shared word form often being their only connection. Wikipedia disambiguation pages support this construction well, since they group ordinary senses with people, places, organizations, titles, and other cultural referents. They also allow us to remove obscure references by checking page views.
blocks.zh:
从某种意义上说,我们的基准是反向的(Navigli,2009年)。 解决者不将给定的单词映射到固定的感知盘点中,而是从数个感知或常规用途中恢复该单词. 也类似于谜语和横向推理的基准(Lin等人,2021年;Jiang等人,2023年b年;Manna等人,2024年;Samdarshi等人,2024年;Saha等人,2025年;Gevers and Daelmans,2026年),但语言特殊,没有答案选择。 解决它需要词汇学知识,候选搜索和证据整合. 检索方向接近于反向词典任务,其中使用描述来查找一个词(Hill等人,2016年;Pilehvar,2019年; Yan et al., 2020 ; Qi et al., 2020 ).
然而,我们的任务却大不相同。 首先,反向词典系统一般从一种感觉的描述中恢复一个词. 此外,这里每个线索被刻意低估,描述了一种不同的感觉. 因此,潜在的解决者必须把候选人综合到跨线索,共享的单词形式往往是他们唯一的连接. 维基百科的解析页面支持这种构建方式,因为它们将普通感官与人,地点,组织,头衔,以及其他文化参考物组合在一起. 它们也使我们能够通过检查页面浏览来删除模糊的引用。

blocks.en: We construct the task in Dutch rather than translate it from English. Translation is useful for cross-lingual comparison, but translation quality and artefacts can affect multilingual benchmark results ( Thellmann et al., 2024 ) . The benchmark does not transfer directly across languages: senses that share a form in Dutch generally use unrelated words in another language. There are several recent benchmarks that are also language or culture specific, such as Korean social values, Persian etiquette and customs, Arabic financial reasoning, and Turkish temporal interpretation ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Sadr et al., 2025 ; Sakhaeirad et al., 2026 ; Elbadry et al., 2026 ; Demir et al., 2026 ) . There are, however, not many that follow our four principles as described in the introduction. Appendix Tables 7 and 8 compare a very broad set on these principles and find that only a few tasks in larger language-specific benchmarks pass all four checks. 2 2 2 We extensively searched for benchmarks and evaluated what we found, but there are many benchmarks these days and we surely missed some. Note that this is not to say that four principles are the only important qualities for a benchmark. There are many more important qualities. But it does highlight that our benchmark possesses interesting qualities that are not common.
blocks.zh: 我们用荷兰语构建这项任务,而不是用英语翻译。 翻译对跨语言比较很有用,但翻译质量和手工艺品会影响多种语言基准结果(Thellmann等人,2024年). 基准不直接跨语言传输:在荷兰语中共享一种形式的感官一般在另一种语言中使用不相关的词. 最近的一些基准也是语言或文化特有的,例如韩国社会价值、波斯礼仪和习俗、阿拉伯金融推理和土耳其时间解释(Lee等人,2024年;Sadr等人,2025年;Sakhaeirad等人,2026年;Elbadry等人,2026年;Demir等人,2026年)。 然而,没有多少符合导言中所述的我们四项原则。 附录表7和表8比较了一套非常宽泛的这些原则,发现在较大的具体语文基准中只有少数任务通过所有四项检查。 2个 2 我们广泛寻找基准并评估了我们发现的情况,但目前有许多基准,我们肯定错过了一些基准。 请注意,这并不是说四项原则是基准的唯一重要品质。 还有许多更重要的品质。 但它确实突出了我们的基准具有不常见的有趣品质。

blocks.en:
There are already a few well-known Dutch LLM benchmarks. DUMB ( de Vries et al., 2023 ) evaluates Dutch language understanding through nine tasks, including part-of-speech tagging, named-entity recognition, word-sense discrimination, pronoun resolution, inference, sentiment, abusive-language classification, and question answering. EuroEval ( Saattrup Nielsen et al., 2025 ) places Dutch in a broader European evaluation suite and covers classification, extraction, summarization, knowledge, common-sense reasoning, and simplification. BEIR-NL adds a task on Dutch information retrieval ( Lotfi et al., 2025 ) .
Appendix Table 9 shows that none of the existing tasks pass all four principles, meaning that we believe our task would be a valuable addition to the community.
blocks.zh:
已经有一些著名的荷兰LLM基准. DUMB (de Vries等人, 2023年) 评价 通过9项任务来理解荷兰语,包括部分语言标记,命名实体识别,词感歧视,代词解析,推论,情绪,虐待语言分类,以及问答. 欧洲-欧洲(Saattrup Nielsen等人,2025年) 在更广泛的欧洲评价套装中,荷兰语涵盖分类、提取、归纳、知识、常识推理和简化。 BEIR-NL增加了荷兰信息检索的任务(Lotfi等人,2025年)。
附录表9显示,现有各项任务都没有通过所有四项原则,这意味着我们认为我们的任务将是对社区的宝贵补充。

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3 基准建设

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 1 , each puzzle has three Dutch clues and one Dutch answer. Each clue describes a different sense or referent of the answer word. Together they should point to one intended answer. We design the clues so that no single clue should identify the answer on its own. Their combination should narrow the possibilities to the intended answer.
For example, in Figure 1 , clues 1 and 2 could also point to Rose , clues 1 and 3 to Boer , and clues 2 and 3 to Kardinaal . 3 3 3 The football coaches are Marco Rose and Frank de Boer. Appendix Table 10 shows ten more puzzle examples.
blocks.zh:
如图1所示,每个谜题有三个荷兰线索和一个荷兰答案. 每条线索都描述了对答案词的不同感知或参考. 它们应共同指出一个预期的答案。 我们设计了线索,这样任何一条线索都不应该单独识别答案. 两者的结合应当将可能性缩小到预期的答案。
例如,在图1中,线索1和2也可以指向罗斯,线索1和3可以指向布尔,线索2和3可以指向卡尔迪纳阿尔. 3 3 3个 足球教练是马可·罗斯和弗兰克·德·布尔. 附录表10列出了另外10个谜题例子。

blocks.en: 3.1 Filtering and Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 过滤和校正

blocks.en: We start by collecting all Dutch Wikipedia disambiguation pages. 4 4 4 For example, the corresponding page for the puzzle in Figure 1 is https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advocaat . The page title then is a candidate answer and descriptions of linked pages are candidate clues. The initial collection has 97,707 pages. We require at least three links (since we want three clues) and remove all short abbreviations. We also only keep titles found in Open Dutch WordNet ( Postma et al., 2016 ) : we want all the answers to be common Dutch words. This ensures that we remove instances for which all the clues point to a given name. 5 5 5 E.g., this way there are no puzzles pointing to 3 pages about people with the common Dutch last name De Jong . Moreover, the puzzles are most interesting when there is a mix of clues. We also filter pages where the clues are not descriptive enough (e.g., too short or numerical).
blocks.zh: 我们首先收集所有荷兰维基百科的混淆页面。 4 4 4 例如,图1中的谜题对应页面是https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advocaat. 然后页面标题是候选答案,链接页面的描述是候选线索. 初集有97,707页. 我们至少需要三个链接(因为我们想要三个线索),并删除所有简称. 我们还只保留Open Dutch WordNet(Postma et al., 2016)中找到的标题:我们希望所有的答案都是常见的荷兰语单词. 5 5 5 E. 如此一来, 没有任何谜题指向 3 页 的荷兰人姓De Jong。 此外,当存在各种线索时,谜题最为有趣. 我们还过滤线索不够描述的页面(如太短或数字).

blocks.en: At this point (4,047 examples left), a manual inspection showed us that the benchmark still has a few problems. For one, some puzzles are too easy, and a single clue often just gives away the answer. On the other hand, some puzzles are simply way too hard, as they for example reference an obscure Dutch city or person that almost no person realistically will have heard of. Moreover, clues are sometimes too similar, which does not lead to an engaging puzzle. 6 6 6 For example, a band may release an album with the same title as the band. Therefore, we apply a few more filters to only keep interesting and engaging puzzles. We filter puzzles by media and place categories, as they overwhelmingly reference obscure places and titles. We also exclude puzzles in which one of the clue descriptions contains the answer directly, and remove repeated descriptions. Then, we filter puzzles that have clues that are too formulaic and Wikipedia-specific, such as "region of", "taxon", and "building in". Finally, as an extra filter for too obscure answers, we filter linked pages below 3,000 views in the previous month.
blocks.zh: 此时(尚存4,047例),人工检查显示,基准还存在一些问题. 对于一个,一些谜题太简单了,一个单一的线索往往只是给出答案而已. 另一方面,有些谜题太难了,例如,它们提到一个几乎没有人会真正听到的模糊的荷兰城市或人。 此外,线索有时过于相似,这不会导致一个介入的谜题. 6 6 6 例如,乐队可能发行一张与乐队标题相同的专辑. 因此,我们使用一些更多的过滤器来保持有趣和接触的谜题。 我们通过媒体和定位类别过滤谜题,因为它们绝大多数都提到模糊的地方和标题。 我们还排除了一个线索描述直接包含答案的谜题,并删除了重复的描述. 然后,我们过滤那些有过于公式化和维基百科特异性的线索的谜题,如"区域","taxon",以及"建设". 最后,作为过于模糊的答案的额外过滤器,我们在上个月过滤了3 000个视图以下的链接页。

blocks.en: At this point (see Table 1 ), we have 2,087 puzzles left, but we can tell there are still clear issues with the resulting puzzles that automatic filtering cannot capture. We turn to manual filtering, with one primary curator, who discussed interesting cases with a second curator. First, we filter all instances where any one of the clues is simply deemed too obscure, or where two clues effectively point to the same sense. This is subjective to some extent: when is something obscure and when is it not? Nevertheless, this is a necessary step, and we trust humans a lot more on this task than LLMs or other automated methods.
blocks.zh: 此时(见表1),我们还有2,087个谜题,但是我们可以分辨出,在由此产生的谜题中,仍然有明显的问题,自动过滤无法捕捉. 我们转而进行人工过滤,由一名初级主管,他与另一名主管讨论有趣的案例。 首先,我们过滤所有 任何一条线索 被简单地认为太模糊 或两个线索 有效指向相同的意义。 这在某种程度上是主观的:什么是模糊的,什么时候不是? 尽管如此,这是一个必要的步骤,我们更相信人类在这项任务上比LLMs或其他自动化方法更可信.

blocks.en: We then have 568 potential puzzles left, but there are still a few more checks to do. For one, we only want puzzles for which all three clues are ideally needed to arrive at the final answer. We therefore filter examples where clearly only one or two clues would be needed to solve the puzzle. This works well, but is also a fine line: we see later in Table 12 that models can still solve some of the puzzles when only seeing one or two clues. Second, we want the puzzle to be completely Dutch-specific. Third, we carefully check that the clues point to one intended answer and that no obvious alternative remains. 7 7 7 Appendix Table 11 lists seven cases that still got past us, detected during error analysis. These alternatives were added as acceptable answers.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们还有568个潜在的谜题,但还有几笔支票需要检查。 首先,我们只想要拼图,最理想地需要所有三个线索才能找到最后的答案。 因此,我们过滤一些例子,这些例子显然只需要一两个线索来解决谜题。 这很有效,但也是一种精细的线条:我们稍后在表12中看到,模型在只看到一两个线索时仍然可以解决一些谜题. 第二,我们希望这个谜题完全针对荷兰人。 第三,我们仔细检查,线索是否指向一个预定的答案,没有明显的替代方案。 7 7 附录表11列出了在错误分析中发现的7个仍然通过我们的案件。 添加了这些替代品作为可接受的答案。

blocks.en:
For the puzzles that pass this check, we manually rewrite the clues.
Wikipedia descriptions were written to identify pages, not to make puzzles. Some contain dates, locations, or parenthetical details that give away too much information, while others are too vague outside the context of the page. We shorten these clues or add just enough context to make them readable, while keeping the underlying sense unchanged.
The final dataset of 222 instances (randomly split into 22 development and 200 test instances) consists entirely of manually reviewed and curated items. 8 8 8 Data and code are available at https://github.com/RikVN/TSW-NL . Licensing details in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
对于通过这次检查的谜题,我们手动重写线索.
维基百科的描述是为了识别页面,而不是制作谜题. 有的包含日期,位置,或括号内的细节,给出了太多的信息,有的则在页面上下文之外过于模糊. 我们缩短这些线索或增加足够的上下文,使其可以读取,同时保持基本意义不变.
222个案例的最后数据集(随机分为22个开发案例和200个测试案例)完全由人工审查和整理的项目组成。 8 8 数据和代码见https://github.com/RikVN/TSW-NL。 附录C中的许可详情

blocks.en: The test set contains 200 carefully curated items. This is relatively small for a benchmark. We prioritize item quality over a larger set containing weaker puzzles. To reduce dependence on clue order, each model is evaluated on all six permutations, producing 1,200 predictions while treating the six predictions for each item as repeated measurements. Also, as Table 3 will later show, the resulting scores still reveal substantial differences between models.
blocks.zh: 测试集包含200个经过精心整理的物品. 就基准而言,这相对较小。 我们把项目质量放在包含较弱谜题的更大的一组之上。 为了减少对线索顺序的依赖,每个模型都对所有6个通量进行评价,产生1200个预测,同时将每个项目的6个预测作为重复测量. 此外,如表3以后所示,所得的分数仍然显示出模型之间的巨大差异。

blocks.en: The items mix lexical senses with names and cultural references. We manually reviewed all 600 test clues and counted the clues tied to a specifically Dutch entity or cultural context. We found 47 such clues (7.8%) across 38 test puzzles (19.0%). Note that the rest of the benchmark is still Dutch-specific through its lexical ambiguity. Across the dataset, models solving this task must handle polysemy, homonymy, metonymic or conventional uses, names of entities, titles, brands or technical senses. These categories can also overlap within an item.
blocks.zh: 这些项目将词汇感与名称和文化参考资料混为一谈。 我们手动审查了所有600条测试线索,并计算了与荷兰实体或文化背景相关的线索。 我们在38个测试谜题(19.0%)中发现了47个这样的线索(7.8%). 请注意,其他基准因其词典模糊而仍然是荷兰特有的。 在整个数据集中,解决这项任务的模型必须处理多语种、同音、计量或常规用途、实体名称、头衔、品牌或技术意义。 这些类别也可在某一项目内重叠。

blocks.en: Because the candidate senses originate from Dutch Wikipedia, pretrained models may benefit from associations acquired from that source, and models may differ in the extent of their exposure. However, all systems are evaluated closed-book, and every open-weight model scores below 40%, indicating that source exposure alone is clearly insufficient to solve the task reliably.
blocks.zh: 由于候选感官起源于荷兰维基百科,经过预先训练的模型可能得益于从该来源获得的协会,模型在曝光程度上可能有所不同. 然而,所有系统都被评价为封闭账本,每个开放量模型得分都低于40%,表明光靠源接触显然不足以可靠地完成任务.

blocks.en: 3.2 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 人类评价

blocks.en:
To get a good sense of human performance, we asked nine annotators to attempt to solve the puzzles, such that each puzzle item had three attempted answers. Seven Dutch speakers answered blocks of 20 or 40 items, together covering the test set once. Two more annotators each answered all 200 items. All nine participants are native speakers and took part voluntarily. The full annotation protocol is available in Appendix B .
It turns out that human annotators can do the task quite well, but they are also far from perfect. The pooled block of 7 annotators contains 103 correct answers (51.5%). The two full-test annotators solved 99 (49.5%) and 122 items (61.0%).
There are still 43 items that no human managed to solve. This confirms that the benchmark remains challenging despite the strict manual filtering for obscure clues.
blocks.zh:
为了获得人类表现的良好感,我们请9位注释家尝试解开谜题,这样每个谜题都有3个尝试的答案. 7名荷兰发言者回答20或40个项目,加起来覆盖了一次测试集。 另有两名注释员各回答所有200项。 所有9名学员都是讲母语的,自愿参加。 说明书全文见附录B。
结果发现,人类的注释员能够相当出色地完成任务,但他们也远远不够完美. 由7个注释器组成的集合区包含103个正确的答案(51.5%). 两个经过全面测试的注释器解决了99件(49.5%)和122件(61.0%).
仍有43件物品无人解决。 这证实,尽管对模糊线索进行了严格的人工过滤,该基准仍然具有挑战性.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: To see how well LLMs do on this benchmark, we test a large number of models. We test instruction-tuned models in a closed-book setting, without retrieval or any Wikipedia or internet access. We define the task as zero-shot: a Dutch prompt explains that the clues point to one word and asks for only that word. 9 9 9 We ran some preliminary experiments in which we explained the task in English instead, and usually obtained slightly worse performance. The exact prompts are available in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 为了了解LLMS在这个基准上做得如何,我们测试了大量模型. 我们在一个封闭的书架上测试 校对的模型,没有检索 或任何维基百科或互联网访问。 我们把任务定义为零拍:一个荷兰的提示解释道,线索指向一个词,只要求这个词. 第9条 9,我们进行了一些初步的实验,我们用英语解释了任务,通常得到的性能略差. 确切提示见附录F。

blocks.en:
We cover Dutch-specific models and multilingual models (with and without reasoning) of varying sizes and families. The benchmark is intended to help open-weight developers evaluate their models, but we understand the curiosity to see how well state-of-the-art closed-source models do. Therefore, we test GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol and include two earlier models from around the time work on this benchmark began, to show progress. Table 2 lists every model and groups them by model type.
To investigate whether further training on Dutch helped the Dutch-specific models, we add the closest instruction-tuned controls for two lineages: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1 for GEITje 7B Ultra and Llama 3 8B Instruct for ChocoLlama 3 8B Instruct.
blocks.zh:
我们涉及荷兰特有的模式和不同规模和家庭的多语种模式(有和没有推理)。 该基准旨在帮助开放量级开发者评估他们的模型,但我们理解好奇心,以了解最新水平的封闭源代码模型做得如何. 因此,我们测试了GPT-5.6 Luna和Sol,并包括了大约在这一基准工作开始的时间内较早的两个模型,以显示进展。 表2列出了每个模型,并按模型类型分类.
为了调查荷兰语的进一步培训是否有助于荷兰语的具体模式,我们增加了对两种语系进行最接近的指令调整控制: Mistral 7B 指令 v0.1 用于 GEITje 7B Ultra 和 Llama 3 8B 用于 ChocoLlama 指令 3 8B 指导.

blocks.en: We design the task as zero-shot: the clues should contain enough information without worked examples. Out of interest, we compared performance using 0, 1, 3, 5, 10, and 22 examples in canonical clue order for a selection of our models, shown in Appendix Table 13 . Differences are generally small, and some models in fact do best with no examples. For the reasoning models, we use the highest reasoning setting available.
blocks.zh: 我们把任务设计为零镜头:线索应该包含足够的信息,而不需要工作的例子. 出于兴趣,我们用0, 1, 3, 5, 10 和22个例子来比较我们的模型, 差异一般很小,有些模型实际上最好没有实例。 对于推理模型,我们使用现有的最高推理设置.

blocks.en: Table 2: Models included in the evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表2:列入评价的模型。

blocks.en:
Our main metric is exact-match accuracy after trimming whitespace and lowercasing.
This is deterministic and requires no subjective or model-based judge.
In our main experiment, every model sees all six clue orders to reduce dependence on any single clue order. We report their mean accuracy and sample standard deviation, which provides an immediate indication of sensitivity to clue order.
We average correctness over the six orders for each item. We obtain 95% confidence intervals by bootstrapping the 200 items. For model comparisons, we use paired sign-flip tests on these item-level scores and paired bootstrap intervals for the accuracy difference, with Holm correction across the family of comparisons. We test clue-order effects by randomly permuting the six order labels within each item. The iteration counts and further implementation details are available in Appendix G .
blocks.zh:
我们的主要衡量标准是 精确的匹配精度 经过裁剪 白空间和低刻。
这是决定性的,不需要主观或以模式为基础的法官。
在我们的主要实验中,每个模型都看到所有六个线索命令,以减少对任何单一线索命令的依赖. 我们报告它们的平均精确度和样本标准偏差,这立即表明对线索顺序的敏感性.
每件物品的六个订单平均正确 我们得到95%的置信间隔 通过拖带200件物品。 在模型比较中,我们对这些物品等级的分数使用对联的标志-flip测试,并对精确度差使用对联的靴子间隔,Holm校正横跨比较的家族. 我们测试线索命令的效果 通过随机穿透 6个命令标签在每个项目。 重复计算和进一步实施详情见附录G。

blocks.en: To further judge the results of the LLMs, we also run a BM25 source-retrieval diagnostic ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) . Note that this is not a fair baseline, as it receives candidate inventories and Wikipedia source material, but it makes for an interesting comparison. Each candidate answer becomes a document containing its linked senses, the three clues form the query, and the title of the highest-ranked document is returned. We use two source-matched pools with linked-page titles and Dutch descriptions: all 2,087 automatically filtered candidates and, as an oracle-like condition, only the 200 test answers. This diagnostic basically asks how directly the clues match their source descriptions and how plausible recovery from memorized source associations would be. BM25 reaches 69.0% with the 2,087-candidate pool and 85.5% with the oracle-like 200-answer pool. This shows that the clues do contain substantial source signal, though it is also far from enough to completely solve the task.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步判断LLMS的结果,我们还进行了BM25源码检索诊断(Robertson和Zaragoza,2009年)。 请注意,这不是一个公平的基线,因为它收到候选清单和维基百科的源材料,但可以进行有趣的比较. 每个候选答案都成为包含其关联感官的文档,三个线索构成查询,排名最高的文档标题被退回. 我们使用两个有链接页标题和荷兰描述的源匹配集合:所有2 087个自动过滤候选人,作为类似甲骨文的条件,只有200个测试答案。 这个诊断基本上问线索如何直接与源头描述相匹配,以及从被记住的源头协会中恢复的可能性如何. BM25与2,087个可考量池达到69.0%,与甲骨文类200个答题池达到85.5%. 这表明线索确实包含了实质性的源信号,虽然也远远不足以完全解决任务.

blocks.en: 4.1 Error annotation
blocks.zh: 4.1 错误注释

blocks.en:
To understand the remaining errors, we manually annotate every answer initially marked incorrect for a subset of models and one human annotator.
We assign each response to one of the following mutually exclusive categories:
blocks.zh:
为了了解剩下的错误,我们手动对每一个最初被标记错误的答案进行注释,用于一个子集模型和一个人类注释.
我们把每项答复分配给下列相互排斥的类别之一:

blocks.en: • Empty : the human left the answer blank, or the model produced no final answer before reaching its token limit. • Repeats (part of) a clue : the answer copies wording from a clue instead of identifying the shared word. • Completely incorrect : none of the other categories apply and the answer does not meaningfully fit the clues. • Fits only one clue : the answer is related to one clue but not the other two. • Fits only two clues : the answer combines part of the evidence but fails on the third clue. • Inflection variant : the answer is morphologically related to an accepted answer, but the produced form does not itself satisfy all three clues. • Correct alternative : another answer that also fits all three clues.
blocks.zh: • 空:人类将答案留空,或者模型在达到符号极限之前没有产生最终答案. • 重复(部分)一条线索:从一条线索复制答案,而不是识别共同的词。 • 支助 完全不正确:其他类别都不适用,答案与线索不符。 • 支助 只符合一条线索:答案与一条线索有关,但与另外两条线索无关. • 支助 只符合两个线索: 答案结合了部分证据,但在第三线索上失败. ^ Inflection变体:答案在形态学上与被接受的答案相关,但生成的形式本身并不能满足所有三个线索. • 支助 正确选择 : 另一个同样符合所有三个线索的答案.

blocks.en: Empty : the human left the answer blank, or the model produced no final answer before reaching its token limit.
blocks.zh: 空:人类将答案留为空白,或者模型在达到符号极限之前没有产生最终答案.

blocks.en: Repeats (part of) a clue : the answer copies wording from a clue instead of identifying the shared word.
blocks.zh: 重复(部分)一条线索:从一条线索复制答案措辞,而不是识别共享的单词.

blocks.en: Completely incorrect : none of the other categories apply and the answer does not meaningfully fit the clues.
blocks.zh: 完全不正确:其他类别都不适用,答案与线索不符。

blocks.en: Fits only one clue : the answer is related to one clue but not the other two.
blocks.zh: 只符合一条线索:答案与一条线索有关,但与另外两条线索无关.

blocks.en: Fits only two clues : the answer combines part of the evidence but fails on the third clue.
blocks.zh: 只符合两个线索: 答案结合了部分证据,但在第三线索上失败.

blocks.en: Inflection variant : the answer is morphologically related to an accepted answer, but the produced form does not itself satisfy all three clues.
blocks.zh: Inflection变体 : 答案在形态学上与被接受的答案相关,但生成的形式本身并不能满足所有三个线索.

blocks.en: Correct alternative : another answer that also fits all three clues.
blocks.zh: 正确选择 : 另一个同样符合所有三个线索的答案.

blocks.en: This analysis also made us realize that checking wrong answers for only a few models is unfair. However, annotating all 18,866 unique non-empty wrong responses across all experiments is not feasible. Therefore, we additionally annotate every previously unreviewed answer that occurs at least six times across the experiments, but only to determine whether the answer should be accepted. 10 10 10 There are six clue orders, so an annotated answer could come from a single model. Of these 532 unique answers, only three should have been accepted. Appendix Table 11 lists all these accepted alternatives, together with the four unique ones found in the more extensive manual annotation (Table 5 ). We then rescore all experiments with the expanded answer key, e.g. allowing some puzzles to have multiple answers. This produces only small changes, but is in our opinion the most fair setup.
blocks.zh: 这一分析还使我们认识到,只为少数模式检查错误答案是不公平的。 然而,在所有实验中对所有18,866种独特的非空错反应进行注释是不可行的. 因此,我们补充注释了每一个在实验中至少发生6次的先前未经审查的答案,但只是为了确定答案是否应该被接受. 10 10 有6个线索命令,所以一个注释的答案可以来自一个单一的模型. 在这532个独特的答案中,只有三个应该被接受. 附录表11列出了所有这些被接受的替代品,以及较广泛的手册注释(表5)中发现的四个独特的替代品。 然后我们用扩展的答案键重回所有实验,例如允许一些谜题有多个答案. 这只产生小的变化,但我们认为是最公平的安排。

blocks.en: Table 3: Test accuracy (%), averaged over the six permutations of the three clues. SD is the sample standard deviation of the six order-level accuracies.
blocks.zh: 表3:测试精度(%),平均于三条线索的6个表层. SD是6个订单级速率的样本标准偏差.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:
Table 3 shows the accuracy scores for the LLMs used in this study. 11 11 11 Appendix Figure 4 shows the same results, but now visualized and with 95% confidence intervals. Scores range from 5.1% (Mistral 7B) to an impressive 88.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Generally, all models except the very best ones clearly struggle with the task. We are happy to see that, as it shows that the benchmark is far from saturated, at least for open-weight and non-reasoning models.
Among the open-weight models, Gemma 3 27B scores highest at 39.3%, followed by Aya Expanse 32B at 32.9% and Ministral 3 14B at 30.8%.
Larger models usually do better than their smaller counterparts, except for the EuroLLM models, which do not differ significantly in score. The Dutch-specific models unfortunately do not perform as well, though it is interesting to see that GEITje and ChocoLlama perform better than Fietje 2 .
blocks.zh:
表3显示了本研究中使用的LLMs的准确分数. 11 11 附录图4显示了同样的结果,但现在可视化,置信间隔为95%. 分数从5.1%(Mistral 7B)到令人印象深刻的GPT-5.6 Sol的88.8%. 一般来说,除最优秀的外,所有模式都明显地与任务相抗衡。 我们高兴地看到这一点,因为它表明,基准远远没有饱和,至少是开放重量和非合理模型的基准。
在开放量级模型中,Gemma 3 27B的得分最高,为39.3%,其次是Aya Expanse 32B,为32.9%,Ministry 3 14B为30.8%.
较大的型号通常比较小的型号做得更好,除了EuroLLM型号外,这些型号在分数上没有显著的差异. 但值得注意的是GEITje和ChocoLlama的表现优于Fietje 2。

blocks.en: The statistical tests support the clearest differences in the table. GPT-5.6 Sol outperforms every other model after Holm correction, while Gemma 3 27B is significantly better than all other open-weight models. In general, we find that clue order has little systematic effect. Of the 27 model conditions shown in Figure 4 , 25 have an uncorrected randomization p > .10 p>.10 . 12 12 12 Llama 3 8B ( p = .011 p=.011 ) and Salamandra 7B ( p = .012 p=.012 ) are the exceptions, but they do not survive Holm correction.
blocks.zh: 统计测试支持表中最明显的差异. GPT-5.6 常规 索尔在Holm校正后超越了所有其他模型,而Gemma 3 27B则明显优于所有其他开放量级模型. 一般来说,我们发现线索顺序几乎没有系统效应. 在图4所示的27个模型条件中,25个有未修正的随机化p > 10 p > 10. 12 12 12 拉玛3 8B(p=011 p=011)和萨拉曼德拉7B(p=012 p=012)是例外,但它们没有存活. 霍尔姆修正。

blocks.en:
To answer this, we compare the GEITje and ChocoLlama models to the two parent models they were based on. We cannot make the same comparison for Fietje 2: its base model, Phi-2, is not instruction-tuned and could not perform the prompted task at all. The picture is mixed. For GEITje it clearly helped, as it reaches 14.8%, compared with 5.1% for its parent model Mistral 7B Instruct.
However, ChocoLlama reaches 15.0%, compared with 14.2% for its parent model Llama 3 8B Instruct, which is not a significant improvement.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们比较了GEITje和ChocoLlama模型与它们所依据的两个母模型. 我们不能对Fietje 2作同样的比较:它的基本模式Phi-2没有经过指示调整,完全无法完成所引发的任务。 情况喜忧参半。 对于GEITje来说,它显然有帮助,因为它达到了14.8%,而对于其母型Mistral 7B 教程来说则达到了5.1%。
然而,ChocoLlama达到15.0%,而其母型为14.2%。 Llama 3 8B 指令,这不是一个显著的改进.

blocks.en: Allowing reasoning makes a large difference for both GPT-5.6 models (see the bottom of Table 3 ). Without it, Luna drops by 24.9 points and Sol by 18.9 points. Even though this is not really a “reasoning” task in the traditional sense, the models clearly benefit from being able to spend more compute on thinking through and evaluating potential answers.
blocks.zh: 允许推理对GPT-5.6两种模型都有很大不同(见表3下方)。 没有它,月球降24.9分,索尔降18.9分. 尽管这实际上不是传统意义上的“合理”任务,但这些模型显然能够通过思考和评估潜在的答案而花费更多的时间。

blocks.en: The dated GPT snapshots at the bottom of Table 3 give a rough view of progress: GPT-4o from November 2024 scores 56.3%, GPT-4.1 from April 2025 scores 59.2%, and GPT-5.6 Sol (July 2026) with max reasoning reaches 88.8%. Of course this is not a controlled architecture comparison, but the 29.6-point difference between GPT-4.1 and Sol shows how much performance on this task changed over roughly fifteen months.
blocks.zh: 表3底部日期为GPT的快照给出了粗略的进度:2024年11月的GPT-4o分数为56.3%,2025年4月的GPT-4.1分数为59.2%,最大推理的GPT-5.6 Sol(2026年7月)达到88.8%. 当然这不是一个可控的架构比较,但GPT-4.1和Sol之间的29.6点差异表明,在大约15个月的时间里,这项任务的绩效发生了多大的变化.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Model accuracy by number of clues. For clarity, only a few models are highlighted in color. The other models are shown in grey. One- and two-clue scores average over the three corresponding clue subsets.

blocks.en:
We created this dataset with the goal that each puzzle could only be reliably solved when combining information from multiple clues, preferably even all three clues. However, in practice models could obviously still get to the right answer by looking at only two clues, or making an educated guess after only one. This ablation experiment is shown in Figure 2 . 13 13 13 Complete scores are available in Appendix Table 12 . We see that having three clues is certainly beneficial, but that models can do reasonably well with two. GPT-5.6 Sol (max) averages only 10.3% with one clue, already 63.2% with two, and all three get the model close to 90%. Most open-weight checkpoints in our selection also improve with more evidence.
One clue is almost never enough (apart from some lucky guesses), but two clues already help the best models a lot. In future work, it would be interesting to run a similar experiment with human annotators, to see if it helps them equally much.
blocks.zh:
我们创建了这个数据集,目的是每个谜题只有在结合了来自多个线索的信息时才能可靠地解开,最好是所有三个线索. 然而,在实际操作中,模型显然仍然可以通过只看两个线索就能得到正确的答案,或者在只看到一个线索后做出一个受过教育的猜测. 附录表12列出了这一消减试验。 我们认为,拥有三个线索当然是有好处的,但这种模型可以用两个来做相当好的. GPT-5.6 Sol(最大)平均只有10.3%有一条线索,已经有63.2%有两条线索,所有三个模型都接近90%. 在我们的选择中,大多数露天检查站也随着更多的证据而改善。
一个线索几乎永远不够(除了一些幸运的猜测),但两个线索已经对最好的模型有很大帮助. 在未来的工作中,与人类的注释者进行类似的实验,看看这是否同样帮助他们。

blocks.en: To answer this, Table 4 groups items by how many of the three human judgments were correct. Model accuracy generally rises with human agreement, so the two notions of difficulty are related. The pattern is not perfectly clear for smaller models, however. Interestingly, GPT-5.6 Sol (max) manages to solve 72.5% of the 43 items missed by all three human judgments. We did manually inspect these instances, but could not pinpoint a single cause. The model simply seems better at generating, selecting and evaluating possible answer candidates.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,表4按三项人类判决中有多少项正确分类。 模型精度一般随着人类的一致而上升,因此两个困难的概念是相互关联的. 然而,对于较小的模型来说,这种模式并不完全清楚。 有趣的是,GPT-5.6 Sol(最大)能解决所有三项人类判断都错过的43项中的72.5%. 我们手动检查了这些情况,但无法找出一个原因。 这一模式似乎更能产生、选择和评价可能的答案候选人。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Table 5: Manual categories for answers initially marked incorrect in zero-shot canonical-order Fietje 2 Instruct, GPT-5.6 runs with max reasoning, and one full-test human annotator.
blocks.zh: 表5:手动解答类别最初在零射孔令菲特杰2指令中标记不正确,GPT-5.6运行时有最大推理,以及一名经过测试的人类注释员.

blocks.en:
We manually categorize the answers initially marked incorrect from one low-performing model (Fietje 2 Instruct), two high-performing models (GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol), and the best full-test human annotator. Usually, when the human annotator or good models make a mistake, their answers still fit one or two clues but fail on the rest (Table 5 ). Luna and Sol even each produced three correct alternatives, and the human annotator did this once. 14 14 14 As noted before, these responses are counted as correct in the final benchmark. Appendix Table 11 lists all accepted alternatives and explains why they are acceptable. Empty is also an interesting category. For the human annotator, this means that they could not come up with an answer they considered good enough and left the line empty. For a model, it means that they did not come up with an answer before running out of reasoning or generation tokens. On inspection, we saw that the models mostly looped through the same answers, and were no longer making meaningful progress when they ran out of tokens.
Fietje is clearly not up to the task: it often repeats all or part of a clue instead of proposing a new answer, or comes up with an answer that only fits a single clue.
blocks.zh:
我们手动从一个低性能模型(Fietje 2 Instruct),两个高性能模型(GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol),以及最优秀的全测试人类注释者中,对最初标记不正确的答案进行分类. 通常,当人类的注释者或好模型犯错时,他们的答案仍然符合一两个线索,但在其余部分却失败(表5). Luna和Sol甚至各自提出了三种正确的替代品,人类注释师也做了一次。 14 14 如上所述,这些答复在最后基准中被计算为正确。 附录表11列出了所有被接受的替代品,并解释了为什么这些替代品可以接受。 空也是一个有趣的类别。 对人类的注释者来说,这意味着他们无法拿出一个他们认为足够好的答案,并留下了线条空空空. 对于一个模型来说,这意味着他们没有在失去推理或代号之前找到答案. 在检查中,我们看到这些模型大多通过同样的答案循环,当它们耗尽象征物时,不再取得有意义的进展。
Fietje显然没有达到任务:它经常重复全部或部分的线索,而不是提出新的答案,或者提出一个只符合单一线索的答案.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced the Dutch LLM benchmark The Shared Word ( TSW-NL ), which combines four properties that rarely occur together in language-model evaluation: it is language-specific, open-vocabulary, deterministically scored, and fully curated by humans. The task is simple to describe but not easy to solve. A model receives three clues for different senses or uses of one Dutch word and has to generate that word.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了荷兰LLM基准The Supposed Word(TSW-NL),它结合了语言模型评价中很少出现的四个属性:它是语言特异性的,开放的-vobulary,决定性的得分,并由人类全方位进行校正. 任务很简单,但不容易解决。 一个模型为不同的感官或使用一个荷兰语单词获得三个线索,必须生成这个词.

blocks.en: The results show both headroom and clear progress. Most models in our selection struggle, and the strongest open-weight checkpoint reaches only 39.3%. GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 score within the range observed for our human annotators, while GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol score substantially higher. The ablations also confirm the intended structure of the task: one clue is rarely enough, two help considerably, and all three give the strongest result.
blocks.zh: 结果显示了头室和明显的进展。 在我们的选拔斗争中,大多数模式,最强的开放重量检查站只达到39.3%. GPT-4o和GPT-4.1在人类注释者观测范围内得分,而GPT-5.6 Luna和Sol的得分则要高得多。 浮雕也证实了任务的意图结构:一个线索很少足够,两个帮助很大,三个都给出了最强的结果.

blocks.en: The benchmark itself is deliberately Dutch, since its lexical relations do not survive translation. The construction process is more general, though. Other languages with similar resources could construct a similar benchmark by following our recipe, though it would require careful manual curation. We hope this work encourages more benchmarks that test language-specific knowledge directly without giving up open generation or clear evaluation.
blocks.zh: 基准本身是刻意的荷兰语,因为其词汇关系在翻译中无法幸存. 不过,建造过程较为普遍。 拥有类似资源的其他语文可以按照我们的食谱来构建一个类似的基准,尽管这需要认真的人工整理。 我们希望这项工作鼓励更多的基准,在不放弃公开生成或明确评价的情况下直接测试具体语言的知识。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: As indicated in the method, our benchmark is relatively small. We chose 200 carefully curated test items over a larger set of weaker puzzles. That choice limits statistical power and perhaps the ability to distinguish between models. We do believe this trade-off between quality and size is worth it in this case.
blocks.zh: 如方法所示,我们的基准相对较小。 我们选了200个精心配制的测试项目 来代替更小的谜题 这种选择限制了统计能力,或许限制了区分模型的能力。 我们认为,在质量和规模之间作出权衡是值得的。

blocks.en: Our benchmark is also just for a single language. This is entirely on purpose: we believe we need more carefully curated, language-specific datasets instead of large, automatic datasets across multiple languages that are not manually verified. The same construction process could be applied to other languages with sufficient disambiguation resources. We sincerely hope future work will look into this.
blocks.zh: 我们的基准也是单一语言。 这是完全出于目的的:我们认为我们需要更仔细地整理,针对具体语言的数据集,而不是跨多种语言的大型自动数据集,这些数据集没有人工验证. 同样的构建过程可以适用于其他语言,并有足够的混杂资源。 我们真诚希望今后的工作将探讨这一问题。

blocks.en: Dataset construction required extensive manual curation. It involved judgments about familiarity, difficulty, and whether an answer would be unique. Only two curators were involved in these decisions. This introduces some subjectivity into item selection, as is unavoidable when curating this kind of puzzle benchmark. A different team might therefore select a somewhat different final set.
blocks.zh: 数据集的构建需要大量人工整理。 它涉及判断熟悉性、困难和答案是否独特。 只有两名主管参与了这些决定。 这给项目选择带来了一些主观性,正如在设计这种谜题基准时不可避免的那样。 因此,不同的团队可以选择一个略有不同的最终组合。

blocks.en: Since the task is derived from Wikipedia, pretrained models may benefit from associations acquired from that source, but the low performance of most evaluated models shows that source exposure alone is not enough. Because the task is open-vocabulary, valid alternatives cannot be guaranteed to be exhaustively known in advance. Therefore, we tried our best to identify such alternatives during error analysis, and updated all scores in the paper taking them into account.
blocks.zh: 由于任务来源于维基百科,经过事先训练的模型可能得益于从该来源获得的协会,但大多数评价模型的低性能表明光靠源接触是不够的. 由于这项任务是开放式的,因此不能保证事先彻底了解有效的替代办法。 因此,我们在错误分析中尽力确定这些替代办法,并更新文件中的所有分数,同时考虑到这些分数。

blocks.en: Finally, TSW-NL is mainly a test of Dutch lexical knowledge, candidate generation, and evidence integration. In particular, while it tests open-vocabulary generation, it does not test generation capabilities beyond just words. We see it as a nice addition to the current evaluation landscape, but not, of course, as a superior benchmark in testing general Dutch capabilities.
blocks.zh: 最后,TSW-NL主要是检验荷兰的词汇学知识,候选生成,以及证据整合. 特别是,虽然它测试了开放的-vobulary生成,但除了单词外,它并不测试生成能力. 我们认为,这是对目前评价前景的一个很好的补充,但当然不是检验荷兰总体能力的优越基准。

blocks.en: Answer frequency has the strongest association with mean model accuracy ( ρ = .45 \rho=.45 ), followed by the number of entries on the original disambiguation page ( ρ = .38 \rho=.38 ) and Wikipedia page views ( ρ = .25 \rho=.25 ). The corresponding correlations are similar for open-weight and proprietary models. Minimum clue frequency, clue length, and the number of clues containing a named entity have little relation to mean model accuracy. These results suggest that familiar answers and richer source pages make an item easier, but that benchmark difficulty is not largely explained by the simple properties tested here.
blocks.zh: 答题频率与平均模型精度关系最强(^45\rho=45),依次为原始解析页的条目数(^38\rho=38)和维基百科的页面视图(^25\rho=25). 相应的关联性对于开放量级和专有型模型类似. 最小的线索频率,线索长度,以及包含一个被命名实体的线索数量与平均模型精度几乎没有关系. 这些结果表明,熟悉的答案和丰富的源页使得一个项目变得更容易,但基准难度主要不是因为这里测试的简单属性.
